definitions.anchor_reason: Start of previously selected I-81/I-82 fine-contact episode. This is a common clock anchor, not identified physical disturbance onset.

classification.dwell_samples: At200Hz,2s requires401 consecutive states and1s requires201, with finite complete clock. Endpoint-only/insufficient-dwell return is right-censored.
classification.inside_at_anchor: Seek first bad-state run lasting >=0.1s whose first state is <=104s; if none, label no_qualifying_departure rather than zero-latency recovery.
classification.later_exits: Report first subsequent qualifying exit and count after primary confirmation, plus remaining-good fraction and last continuous good tail through133s. These can include new terrain disturbances; not automatically same-event overshoot.
classification.later_tail: A final uninterrupted good tail must meet2s to be sustained-through-end; distinguish this from an earlier2s recovery followed by new exits.
classification.outside_at_anchor: Left-censored onset; elapsed return from common anchor is reported, not claimed latency since physical disturbance onset.
classification.return: Search from anchor/departure for first entry starting a continuous good run with full dwell. Report both entry and confirmation times. First threshold entry is also reported without calling it sustained recovery.

criteria.path_full: path_motion AND abs(world-z spin)<=0.05rad/s. Separate strict motion recovery.
criteria.path_motion: Geometric AND full XY velocity residual to spatial nominal <=20mm/s AND own-reference up error <=2deg AND absolute tilt <=15deg. Primary translational/balance recovery; no free-heading angle target.
criteria.timed_full: timed_motion AND same absolute world-z spin bound.
criteria.timed_motion: Timed XY error <=20mm AND full XY velocity residual to original clocked reference <=20mm/s AND same up/tilt conditions.

report: First entry,2s sustained and1s sensitivity for every criterion
Left/right censoring and no qualifying departure explicitly
Spatial progress and clocked progress lag, along/cross velocity residuals
Global geometric versus intended-section distance kept separate
Peak departure and integral error/excess over100.5to133,focus100.5to104
Held command clipping and command steps with each arm's actual bounds and original0.30 scale
Residual spin separately from translational return
Thresholds are engineering preferences, not stability guarantees; no causal attribution of every later departure

route.lower_boundary_clamp: Flag and report; not silently discarded or used as a different branch.
route.projection: Exact clipped segment projection on the original full-grid last quarter: 1025 vertices, 1024 segments; deterministic smallest-u tie. No parameter wrap or branch selected from actual outcomes.
route.spatial_velocity: At fractional projected u, invert u=10*r^3-15*r^4+6*r^5 on [0,1] with 60 fixed bisection iterations; nominal tangent velocity is R*c_prime(u)*30*r^2*(1-r)^2/120. Endpoints u=0/1 have zero nominal speed. This retains original speed profile in space without a timed-position deadline.

definitions.scope: New descriptive recovery assessment of existing I-82 recordings; old outcomes already known. Definitions fixed before these new reductions, not blind preregistration and not a change to I-82 acceptance gates.

scope: Previously known I-82 outcomes; new descriptive metrics fixed before new reductions, not blind preregistration. No simulator/controller calls.
